input.description: the input tensor of shape `(B?, L)` where `B?` is an optional batch dimension

hop_length.description: the distance between neighboring sliding window frames. Default: ``None`` (treated as equal to ``floor(n_fft / 4)``)

win_length.description: the size of window frame and STFT filter. Default: ``None`` (treated as equal to :attr:`n_fft`)

window.description: the optional window function. Shape must be 1d and `<= n_fft` Default: ``None`` (treated as window of all :math:`1` s)

center.description: whether to pad :attr:`input` on both sides so that the :math:`t`-th frame is centered at time :math:`t \times \text{hop\_length}`. Default: ``True``

pad_mode.description: controls the padding method used when :attr:`center` is ``True``. Default: ``"reflect"``

normalized.description: controls whether to return the normalized STFT results Default: ``False``

onesided.description: controls whether to return half of results to avoid redundancy for real inputs. Default: ``True`` for real :attr:`input` and :attr:`window`, ``False`` otherwise.

return_complex.description: whether to return a complex tensor, or a real tensor with an extra last dimension for the real and imaginary components.

output.description: A tensor containing the STFT result with shape `(B?, N, T, C?)` where - `B?` is an optional batch dimension from the input. - `N` is the number of frequency samples, `(n_fft // 2) + 1` for `onesided=True`, or otherwise `n_fft`. - `T` is the number of frames, `1 + L // hop_length` for `center=True`, or `1 + (L - n_fft) // hop_length` otherwise. - `C?` is an optional length-2 dimension of real and imaginary components, present when `return_complex=False`.
